source: D&D 5e SRD / Lost Mine of Phandelver stat blocks. Sizes are the SRD size category; every field is overridable per-roster via a '#' override line or a sidecar creatures.local.json.
notes: archetype drives both the procedural fallback silhouette and the skeleton of the gen-AI art prompt. palette = [primary, shadow, accent].

goblin.art: wiry green-skinned goblin, oversized ears, scimitar and battered wooden shield, scrap leather armour

hobgoblin.art: disciplined orange-skinned hobgoblin soldier, lamellar armour, longsword and kite shield

bugbear.art: hulking hairy bugbear, hunched shoulders, morningstar, fur and hide straps
